resource_overview.purpose: Distill a reusable admission gate from repository governance and executable sync behavior.
resource_overview.structure: A governance rule defines intent, a Python checker defines dependency semantics, and a shell command exposes the delivery boundary.
limitations: The fixture proves contract completeness, not that every future Skill dependency is appropriate.

sources.applicable_scope: installable Skill selection and sync refusal
sources.freshness_risk: re-run dry-run after sync behavior changes

capabilities.stable_responsibility: Reject unavailable hard install dependencies without converting conditional runtime collaboration into a hard dependency.
trigger_signals: an installable Skill declares another Skill in requires
non_trigger_signals: a Skill only routes to another capability when domain evidence appears at runtime
preconditions: the caller and dependency admission metadata are readable
ordered_procedure: classify the relationship as hard install dependency or conditional runtime collaboration
validate hard dependencies against admission status
run sync dry-run for the caller
branches_and_failures: stop when a true hard dependency is missing or candidate
remove requires when the relationship is only conditional runtime routing
recovery_or_stop_conditions: delivery remains blocked until dependency semantics and admission evidence agree
acceptance_evidence: the caller passes dependency validation without installing optional capabilities
capabilities.version_and_freshness: valid for the repository admission schema as of 2026-08-03
capabilities.support_rationale: Governance, checker behavior, and sync behavior jointly distinguish install dependencies from runtime routing.

predictive_test.rationale: The contract predicts that a new caller with optional domain routing can sync while the candidate domain Skill remains blocked.

non_obviousness.rationale: Without this distinction, a valid optional collaboration can silently disable unrelated core Skills.
